lines.zh: 我在水里缓缓划动四肢
lines.en: I paddle slowly through the water

lines.zh: 甲壳上的纹路像古老的图
lines.en: The patterns on my shell look like ancient maps
I need not go up for air
I swim along the riverbed
My flippers push the waterweeds aside
I swim from the sea into the estuary
Seaweed still clings to my shell
I swim slowly, but never stop
I crawl two steps on the shallows

lines.zh: 我拖着厚重的壳在水里转身
lines.en: I turn my heavy shell around in the water

lines.zh: 我从河底的石头上面滑过去
lines.en: I slide over the stones on the riverbed

lines.zh: 我的鳍足一前一后地划
lines.en: My flippers paddle front and back
I head for deeper water

lines.zh: 我用鳍足在沙上推出一道沟
lines.en: I push a groove in the sand with a flipper
I settle on the riverbed sand
My head is half drawn into my shell
The current passes over my shell
I wait for small fish to pass
My limbs are spread out

lines.zh: 我在一呼一吸间慢慢沉浮
lines.en: I rise and sink slowly with each breath
My shell is harder than stone

lines.zh: 我在水底听着远处的浪
lines.en: I listen to distant waves on the bottom

lines.zh: 我的头从壳里伸出来又缩回去
lines.en: My head comes out of the shell and back in
I lie on the bottom without moving
The seaweed on me sways with the current

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直看着上方
lines.en: My eyes keep watching above

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在河底的沙上
lines.en: I rest my chin on the riverbed sand
I rock my head slowly
Do you want to ride
My back is wide enough to sit on
You carry no damp
I am not the fierce sort

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我伸出头等你。
lines.en: You crouch at the water's edge; I stretch my neck out to you.
I lift my head out of the water at you

lines.zh: 我的鳍足拍了一下水面
lines.en: My flipper slaps the water once
Do not step on the edge of my shell
You can come a little closer
I will not move suddenly
Your shadow wavers on the surface
I have carried many riders
The rim of my shell is a little slippery
If you reach out, I will lift my head
We are in no hurry, the water keeps flowing
I know these waters
My shell was struck
A white mark is left on it
It does not hurt much, only discomfort
I sink deeper

lines.zh: 我把头缩回壳里，只留眼睛。
lines.en: I pull my head into the shell, eyes only.
A cut opened on my flipper
A mark is left on my shell
I sank a little in the water
I can endure this wound
I draw my neck back into the shell
Is that the smell of seafood
I do like this

lines.zh: 你放在水里，我自己去拿
lines.en: Put it in the water and I will get it
I am not fussy, but it must be easy to bite
This will be gone in one bite
Step back a little and I will come up
I drift slowly toward the bank

lines.zh: 你手里那是海里的东西
lines.en: You hold something from the sea
I cannot mistake that smell
I float up a little
Let me taste it first
It makes me hungry just to smell it
You strike my shell and slide off to one side.

lines.zh: 你顶在我壳上，我还在往前划。
lines.en: You shove my shell; I keep paddling on.
My shell bounced you off
I gave a little way in the water
My flipper touched your leg

lines.zh: 我壳上连道印子都没留下。
lines.en: Not even a scratch is left on my shell.

lines.zh: 你踩在我壳边滑了一下
lines.en: You slipped on the rim of my shell

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半格给你腾地方
lines.en: I shift half a block to make room for you
I barely sway in the water
I shift my shell to one side
I only think of this in the deep sea
My time is long, I am in no hurry
We bury our eggs in the sand
This need not be discussed here
I turn my head back to the water
My eggs will be buried in the sand
We come back here every year
I lower my head toward the water

lines.zh: 我把鳍足搭在沙上，慢慢想着
lines.en: I lay a flipper on the sand and think slowly

lines.zh: 我们不争不抢，一年一年地来
lines.en: We do not fight or grab, we come year by year
I scoop it into my mouth
I can eat this
I pin it with a flipper

lines.zh: 水里掉的东西我都能找到
lines.en: I can find anything that falls in the water
It slipped away, I chase it again
I sweep it over with a flipper
My jaws can crush this
I hold it under my shell

lines.zh: 水里的东西都会沉到底
lines.en: Everything in the water sinks to the bottom

lines.zh: 我用鳍足把它拨到嘴边。
lines.en: I nudge it to my mouth with a flipper.
Something is moving on the bottom
I turn to face it
I swim slowly, but I can wait

lines.zh: 它游不出我这一口能到的范围。
lines.en: It cannot swim beyond the reach of one bite.

lines.zh: 水面下，我朝那边转了向。
lines.en: Under the surface, I turn toward it.
There is movement in the water ahead
I raise my head out of the water to look
I swim that way along the bottom
This is not fast to me

lines.zh: 我把身体转正了对着它
lines.en: I square my body toward it

lines.zh: 我的鳍足已经准备好了
lines.en: My flippers are ready
I am in no hurry, and it cannot escape
I follow that rippling line
My flipper rhythm has not changed
It circles ahead of me
I wait for it to stop and breathe

lines.zh: 我的甲壳挡住了一半视线
lines.en: My shell blocks half my view
I follow its shadow
It swims above, I below
I wait for it to come near the water
It is one block from my head
I keep low against the riverbed
I wait for it to enter the shallows
I slowly shorten the distance
I strike with my flipper
One shove of my head is enough
The splash goes high
I sink back into the water after the blow
I surge up from under the water

lines.zh: 我的鳍足拍在它的腿上
lines.en: My flipper slaps its leg
I knock it into the shallows
I sink back after the blow

lines.zh: 鳍足扫过去，像推了一块石头。
lines.en: My flipper sweeps across like a shove against stone.
I ram with my whole shell
I pin it from the side
This one of mine is heavy

lines.zh: 水面拱起一块，是我的背。
lines.en: The surface bulges — that is my back.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳顶开浮萍，慢慢升起。
lines.en: My shell parts the duckweed and slowly rises.
Ocean, river, swamp, I live in all
I can carry a rider

lines.zh: 我的鳍足在浅滩上撑住
lines.en: My flippers brace on the shallows

lines.zh: 我转得很慢，水纹却很大。
lines.en: I turn slowly, yet the ripples spread wide.
I surface from the sea
My shell looks like a floating island
I can carry a rider across a river

lines.zh: 我的鳍足在浅水里撑住身体
lines.en: My flippers brace my body in the shallows
I can live in swamps too
I slowly put my head out

lines.zh: 我的速度不快，但不会沉
lines.en: I am not fast, but I will not sink

lines.zh: 我身上带着海水的味道
lines.en: I carry the smell of seawater

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我不敢上去
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface, I dare not rise

lines.zh: 我从不高的地方摔进水里
lines.en: I fell from a low place into the water

lines.zh: 我不会淹死，但水太多也闷
lines.en: I cannot drown, but too much water stifles
The underwater shock pushed me askew
An arrow stuck in my flipper

lines.zh: 那股术力透过了我的壳
lines.en: That magic passed through my shell
I have not found seafood yet
The bolt in the water left me stunned
The water is gone and I hang suspended
